items.information:
**PLEASE NOTE: This competition takes place on a MONDAY NIGHT during Winter Break!**

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OKCHolidayWeeknight2025#64864-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OKCHolidayWeeknight2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.
